title: Quantum-Hydrodynamic Feedback (QHF): Gross-Pitaevskii Condensate Solver and Quantum Bridge
description: Gross-Pitaevskii fluid solver with 16 cognitive modes, split-step Fourier kinetic step, and hardware-verified 2-qubit quantum bridge on 156-qubit superconducting QPUs. Contains the full measurement audit trail, replay gates, and classical reference suites. Key result: 80-iteration closed-loop run on ibm_marrakesh (Heron r2) shows discrete bimodal stabilization (H/Hmax = 0.3727, p = 0.030); single-qubit equivalence proven; no quantum advantage detected.
